en: A black-and-white aerial photograph showing a baseball stadium surrounded by open fields, a river, and dense forest. Behind the stadium is a grid of neatly laid-out residential buildings, suggesting a planned community. The stadium features a baseball diamond and a grandstand. The overall setting appears mid-20th century, and the area is likely part of a newly developed or expanding town.
